If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.3 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is flat, shift forecast downward by 2–3% for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is flat, shift forecast upward by 2–3% for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).
